extracted.intended_audience: machine learning researchers, NLP practitioners, and patent analytics/technology intelligence practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating and applying text-based patent embeddings (SBERT-based) for patent-to-patent similarity, semantic search, and automated multi-label CPC classification at scale. Focus is on model design (embeddings + KNN), validation against CPC overlap, and reporting accuracy/F1 on large patent corpora.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Sentence-BERT (SBERT) on patent claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Create embeddings using Sentence-BERT (SBERT) based on patent claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage SBERT's ability to produce semantic sentence/passage embeddings from patent claim text as the primary textual representation for downstream similarity and classification tasks. The paper emphasizes claims as the text source for embedding creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scalable p2p similarity mapping
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage SBERTs efficiency in creating embedding distance measures to map patent-to-patent (p2p) similarity in large sets of patent data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embeddings and distance measures must be efficient enough to compute and compare similarities across very large patent corpora; scalability and runtime efficiency are key evaluation criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation of p2p similarity via CPC overlap
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate that the p2p similarity captures technological features in terms of Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) overlap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CPC class overlap between patents as an external, domain-relevant validation signal to assess whether embedding-based similarity corresponds to technological relatedness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simple KNN-based classification framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Deploy a classification framework where a Nearest Neighbors (KNN) model predicts the CPC of a patent based on the class assignment of the K patents with the highest p2p similarity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor simple, interpretable classifiers (e.g., KNN over embedding space) that directly leverage p2p similarity; selection of K and tie-breaking/aggregation for multi-label assignment are actionable design choices to report and tune.

rubrics_metrics.name: Out-of-sample, large-scale multi-label evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform out-of-sample model validation and multi-label prediction of all assigned CPC classes on the subclass (663) level across 1,492,294 patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report results on held-out data at realistic, fine-grained CPC levels and at large scale to demonstrate real-world applicability and robustness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary performance metrics: Accuracy and F1 score
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate classification performance using accuracy and F1 score; the paper reports an accuracy of 54% and F1 score > 66% for the stated multi-label subclass task.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use both accuracy and F1 (harmonic mean of precision and recall) for multi-label/multi-class evaluation; report absolute metrics and compare to state-of-the-art baselines to justify improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretability and end-user evaluability
rubrics_metrics.description: The presented classification framework is simple and the results easy to interpret and evaluate by end-users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize model designs and outputs that are transparent and interpretable so that patent analysts and other end-users can understand and validate predictions (e.g., showing nearest neighbor patents that support a predicted CPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability to downstream IP tasks
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate applicability of the embedding + classification framework for semantic IP search, patent landscaping, and technology intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether embeddings and similarity measures can be directly used for related tasks beyond classification (search, clustering, landscape analysis); provide examples or case studies showing usefulness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Future validation and improvement via multi-source embeddings and expert-curated STS datasets
rubrics_metrics.description: Point towards leveraging multi-source patent embeddings and improving/validating patent embeddings by creating domain-expert curated Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) benchmark datasets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize limitations of current benchmarks and plan for creating or using expert-labeled STS datasets; consider combining multiple patent text sources (claims, abstracts, descriptions, metadata) to produce richer embeddings.
